quantize_array: quantize a numpy array to discrete levels between a min and max value
dequantize_array: dequantize a discrete array back to continuous float values using min max and levels
quantize_with_custom_dtype: quantize a numpy array to discrete levels and return results as a specific numpy dtype
dequantize_with_custom_dtype: dequantize a discrete array back to continuous values with a specified output dtype
roundtrip_quantize_dequantize: quantize then dequantize a numpy array to verify lossy compression roundtrip accuracy
